subpages.text: Solutions Education SMB Municipal/Healthcare Products Switches Network Accessories Wireless Security Legacy Support Warranty FAQ Case Studies White Papers Webinar Request Support Ticket Find a Solution Publications About Us Contact Amer Mounts × Select Page Home / Network Accessories / PoE Injectors / PIG30 PIG30 PoE 10/100/1000Base-T Injector 802.3at Categories: Network Accessories , PoE Injectors Description Downloads Reviews (0) Description The PIG30 is a 10/100/1000 PoE+ injector which gives you the ability to supply power to your network devices. You can supply power to a supported telephone, IP camera, or any other supported PoE device. This injector adds 30W of power to a RJ-45 connection.The PIG30 eliminates the need for an external power supply and its associated AC/DC power cabling, providing a compact, affordable, safe and reliable power solution over existing Ethernet infrastructure. Features: – IEEE802.3af, IEEE802.3at – Up to 30W of power on 4-pairs. – Supports 10/100/1000 Base-T applications – Auto detects and protects PoE+ equipment from being damaged by incorrect installation – Overload and short circuit protection – LED indicators power input and PoE+ output indication – Distance up to 100 meters – Internal AC/DC converter – no need for external power brick – Easy plug-and-play installation – Wall-Mountable design Downloads PIG30 Spec Sheet Reviews There are no reviews yet. subpages.title: SGRD16 | Amer Networks
subpages.text: Solutions Education SMB Municipal/Healthcare Products Switches Network Accessories Wireless Security Legacy Support Warranty FAQ Case Studies White Papers Webinar Request Support Ticket Find a Solution Publications About Us Contact Amer Mounts × Select Page Home / Switches / Unmanaged Switches / Gigabit 10/100/1000 / SGRD16 SGRD16 16-Port 10/100/1000Base-T Gigabit Ethernet Desktop Switch Categories: Switches , Unmanaged Switches , Gigabit 10/100/1000 Description Additional information Downloads Description This fanless 16-port 1000Base-T Gigabit Ethernet Switch provides seamless integration for your network. Made with a sturdy metal housing and the ability to be mounted on a desktop or in a standard 19” rack with the included rack mount kit, the SGRD16 is an ideal solution for new networks and upgrades to existing ones. High performance and ease of use is what the SGRD16 is all about, with a 32Gbps switching fabric and 16 10/100/1000Mbps auto-negotiation and auto-MDIX ports. New energy saving features are supported with power being distributed based on cable length and on link status of ports. Features: 16×10/100/1000Mbps Auto-Negotiation, Auto-MDIX Ethernet Ports Compliant with IEEE802.3/IEEE802.3u standards 32Gbps Switching fabric Store-and-Forward switching architecture with non-blocking wire-speed performance Provides 8K MAC address entries Reduce power consumption – base on Ethernet cable length when link-on – when networking cable is disconnected Sturdy metal housing Diagnostic LEDs Plug & Play installation Additional information Standards IEEE 802.3; IEEE 802.3u; IEEE 802.3x; IEEE 802.3z IEEE802.3ad Network Media Ethernet: UTP/STP Cat-3, 4, 5 Fast Ethernet:UTP/STP Cat-5, 5e,6 Gigabit Ethernet:UTP/STP Cat-5e,6 Data Rate: Ethernet: 10Mbps/20Mbps(half/full-duplex) F
